items.title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
items.description: The Ukrainian president says the slowed-down internet is making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.

items.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
items.description: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.

items.title: Mexican drug lord Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo dies age 80
items.description: Known as the 'Boss of Bosses', he was the head of all-powerful Guadalajara Cartel in the 1980s before his arrest broke up his drug organisation.

items.title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating
items.description: Han Won-seok, 34, confessed to using a hidden camera and AI to get a near-perfect mark on the significant test.

items.title: Pope Leo rides in helicopter cockpit during Peru trip
items.description: The Pope took to the skies before arriving in Cusco on the penultimate day of his Latin America tour.

items.title: Steering failure preceded New Orleans cruise ship collision, says NTSB
items.description: Preliminary findings by National Transportation Safety Board investigators suggest the tanker suffered a "steering casualty" before colliding with the cruise ship on Friday.

items.title: Czechs rally against plan to switch funding of public media
items.description: Protesters say the move will stifle media freedom, while the government insists broadcasters need to cut costs.

items.title: Police ban protests near 10 schools and five universities in Paris
items.description: The order will be in place from 16 to 20 November, Paris police chief Patrice Faure says.

items.title: Three men sentenced to death in Jordan over fatal church mass shooting
items.description: The attack on funeral at a Greek Orthodox church killed nine and injured 34 others last month.

items.title: Clothing factories shut in Bangladesh as workers strike over pay
items.description: Workers are striking over demands for a minimum wage of 30,000 taka (£182) a month.

items.title: Thousands of US flights still cancelled or delayed two days after grounding of planes nationwide
items.description: The US transport secretary says that normal air-traffic operations may not be restored until Monday.

items.title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
items.description: It marks the second attack on the country in three days and comes as the US and Iran remain locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz.
